knowledge.title: Backend engineer — Example Cloud
knowledge.narrative: Built Python APIs and asynchronous workers for a small developer platform. Added request tracing and revised core endpoints, reducing p95 latency by 20%. Documented the rollout and helped four colleagues operate the services.

knowledge.title: Reliable deployment workflow
knowledge.narrative: Designed a typed deployment workflow with health checks and rollback. Reduced the manual deployment procedure from nine steps to three and made release status visible to the team.
